title: Hardcore 4x4
overview:
In a run-down and dangerous area, your opponents use every trick imaginable to force you out of the race... Your adrenaline level shoots up as you drive across six of the most run-down off-road tracks and have to rely completely on your wits and your skills to stay in the race... You will break into a sweat as you fight your way through daring skids and spins...

...But what of it - after all, you are facing the greatest challenge of your life.
